metadata.title: Towards differential expansion for generic representations
metadata.abstract: We report the first results of phenomenological analysis, based on extended set of explicitly calculated colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials in \cite{knotebook}. They concern differential expansion (DE), which separates the dependencies on the knot ${\cal K}$ and the representation $R$. %of colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials. DE is well understood for symmetric and rectangular representations, while for non-rectangular $R$ even the knot-independent basis $Z_R^X$ of DE is not known. We concentrate on two issues: the possible derivation of DE and on improved characteristic of its defect. We discuss how evolution families -- twist knots, double braids and 3-pretzels -- can be used to find DE by a peculiar triangular transformation of evolution coefficients. Once $Z^R_X$ are found for particular family, they are expected to stay basically the same for arbitrary knots -- modulo controllable reductions, characterized by the defect of DE, which puts knots into different universality classes. Contrary to original expectation, these classes appear labeled not by a single number $\delta^{\cal K}$, but by a whole non-decreasing sequence $\{k_j\}$, which is squeezed between two staircases, ${\rm entier}\left(\frac{j-1}{\delta+1}\right)\leq k_j\leq{\rm entier}\left(\frac{j-1}{{\rm deg}\,\Delta}\right)$, where the upper bound involves Alexander polynomial $\Delta(q^2)$ and follows from the continuation of the Melvin--Morton--Rozansky-Kashaev limit to $A=q^{-m}$ with $m>0$, when the limit gives a {\it positive} power of Alexander. The old assumption $\delta+1={\rm deg}\,\Delta$ is oversimplified and fails for 19 non-alternating knots with 11 and 12 crossings. Last, we list the differences of non-rectangularly colored HOMFLY for various mutant pairs to demonstrate their universality (knot-independence) and nice consistency with the spirit of DE.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 彩色结多项式的现象分析
analysis.workSummary: 以显式彩色 HOMFLY–PT 数据探索非矩形表示的 differential expansion，用演化族和三角变换研究基底与 defect，并指出单一 defect 数的旧假设被若干结例否定。
analysis.breakthrough: 提出以非降序列替代单一数值描述 universality 类的细化图景。
analysis.limitations: 整体上是现象分析与初步结果，通用基底和跨任意结的延拓仍有预期性内容。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 用于语言编辑、数值验证程序编写及制图，全部结果由作者检查。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 AI 用于语言编辑、数值验证程序编写及制图，全部结果由作者检查。
